info.title: LedgerFlow AI API
info.description: Invoice processing: OCR, structured extraction, deterministic validation, duplicate detection, PO matching and human approval workflows.

post.description: Create a new company workspace with its first Admin user.
Invalidates all of the user's issued tokens (token_version bump) and clears the cookie.

Always returns the same message to avoid account enumeration.

Email delivery is NOT configured in this build. In development+demo mode only,
the reset token is returned so the flow can be exercised locally.

delete.description: Users are deactivated, not deleted, so audit history stays attributable.
Archives by default. hard=true deletes only if the supplier has no invoices or POs.
Cancels a PO referenced by invoices; deletes it otherwise.

get.description: Authorised file access. Storage is never exposed directly to clients.
Compressed PNG preview of one page (works in every browser, low memory).

post.description: Run OCR + extraction + checks on an uploaded document and create an invoice for review.

put.description: Human review/correction. Checks re-run automatically so results never go stale.

delete.description: Invoices are archived, never hard-deleted, to preserve the audit trail.

get.description: JSON preview (first 500 rows) of a report.
Read-only. There are intentionally no endpoints to modify or delete audit entries.
Activity timeline for one record (available to all roles that can read invoices).
